display_name: LoRa W24 正交相位对称的固定幅度修正
description: Evaluate C2 and C4 pull-back means of one frozen native direction head at exactly the original center/edge edit norms.
authorization: Active LoRa DURA performance research goal.

code.environment: N607 CPU, two inference threads, two replay subprocesses. Original frozen W24 CPU archive.
code.cwd: Immutable release controller; archived E104 evaluator directory for predict and score.

data.representation: Continuous 8192 complex samples at 1 MHz through DURA; untouched W24 front end receives the resulting packet.
data.physical_ids_ref: One real source U smoke package and the same ordered 300 source V physical packets recorded in the original fixed-dose comparison.
data.label_map_ref: Original W24 frozen class mapping; target labels scorer only
data.validation_ref: Reuse VALIDATED_ONCE lora_full_packets_v1 registered V order and true E104.
data.leo_config_ref: Registered native Full clean and six practical views.

permissions.claim_scope: Source-only. Cohort phases are generated from fixed, globally rotating the receive IQ and edit; no model training. Source pose simulator truth only measures post-output geometry; only independent scorer reads V TX.

checkpoint.initialization: Read same archived 24,000 step exact-additive base and frozen 24,000 step direction head without modification.

sources.role: Exact terminal frozen 24,000 update direction head and original optimizer budget.
Fixed source-only Practical exact-additive 24000 update checkpoint for both readouts.
Independent source evaluation after direction checkpoint freeze.
Independent, immutable source predictions for exact endpoint parity.

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Exact r01 current terminal checkpoint, original parent, E104 readout, 300 source V IDs and endpoint parity.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen parent of the same LoRa source contract; original source-only checkpoint
checkpoint.selection_rule: One C4 candidate fixed before scoring. Against original direction six correct >= +18, six CI lower >0, low urban >= +6, clean at least source direct. C2 ablation ineligible.

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, two inference threads with two replay workers.
execution.stop_rule: Stop on binding, real checkpoint, original control parity, fixed regional norm, prediction completeness or score failure. Retain output and preserve other runs.

metric_names: center and edge norm parity and complex angle

rows.method: One full-packet phase and IQ direction head with separate hard pre-RMS center and edge norms
rows.seed_notes: New source fit seed 2026112991; registered V panel and Full draw; independent E104 seed 2026092702.
rows.budget_ref: No parameter updates. 300 source V x seven views x five readouts. Four fixed phase evaluations of one frozen direction head.

notes: Use the unchanged native 8192 capture. Undo phase before taking mean and before projecting to original W24.
Preserve center and edge edit L2 norms independently, then apply native W24 normalization. Direction head only is symmetrized; base DURA is unchanged.
Known noise is used for post-prediction source geometry only and does not choose any transformation.
